name: Ospemifene pivotal studies
question: Does oral ospemifene improve vaginal atrophy findings and bothersome dryness or dyspareunia compared with placebo in postmenopausal women?

design.population: Postmenopausal women with at most 5% superficial vaginal cells, vaginal pH above 5.0, and at least one moderate or severe symptom of vulvovaginal atrophy.

verdictNote: All coprimary endpoints met at 60 mg; 30 mg missed dyspareunia.
takeaway: In the Bachmann phase 3 trial, oral ospemifene 60 mg daily improved vaginal cytology, pH, and most-bothersome dryness or dyspareunia versus placebo at 12 weeks; 30 mg did not significantly improve dyspareunia.

reports.label: Initial three-arm trial
reports.dateLocator: Crossref published-print: May 2010; day and online date not supplied
reports.citation: Bachmann GA, Komi JO, Ospemifene Study Group. "Ospemifene effectively treats vulvovaginal atrophy in postmenopausal women: results from a pivotal phase 3 study." *Menopause.* 2010;17(3):480-486. doi:10.1097/gme.0b013e3181c1ac01

results.measure: Change in percentage of superficial cells at week 12
results.note: Both 60 mg and 30 mg were statistically significantly superior to placebo; absolute changes were not stated in the abstract.

results.measure: Change in percentage of parabasal cells at week 12
results.note: Both doses were statistically significantly superior to placebo; absolute changes were not stated in the abstract.

results.measure: Change in vaginal pH at week 12
results.note: Both doses were statistically significantly superior to placebo; absolute changes were not stated in the abstract.

results.measure: Change in severity of dryness or dyspareunia at week 12
results.note: The 60-mg dose met the coprimary symptom endpoint; 30 mg was significant for dryness but not dyspareunia. Absolute changes were not stated in the abstract.

delivery.label: Treatment and cointervention
delivery.value: Oral ospemifene 30 or 60 mg/day or placebo for 12 weeks; all participants received nonhormonal vaginal lubricant for use as needed.
